newsitem.title: USA: AMDL says its test to undergo more review.
newsitem.headline: AMDL says its test to undergo more review.

text.p: AMDL Inc said Friday that the Food and Drug Administration has asked it to withdraw its application for market approval of its PyloriProbe, a diagnostic test for Helicobacter pylori.
The company said the FDA is seeking more clinical data for the diagnostic test.
Helicobacter pylori is a bacterium associated with chronic gastritis, and gastric and duodenal ulcers. It can eventually lead to stomach cancer.

"Additional clinical studies of PyloriProbe are in progress at several medical schools and medical centers, and once the data is collected and reviewed, we will resubmit our application to the FDA," AMDL President and Chief Executive That Ngo said in a statement.
